# vappcloud_project (Resource)

A VAppCloud project. Projects are the tenant boundary for devices, VMMs, compute, and applications.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vappcloud_project" "production" {
  name        = "production"
  description = "Production workloads managed by OpenTofu."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Project description.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `id` (String) Opaque public resource identifier.
- `resource_version` (Number) Optimistic concurrency version.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp in RFC3339 format.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Maximum time to wait for the create operation. Accepts Go duration syntax such as `30s` or `2h45m`; defaults to `5m0s`.
- `delete` (String) Maximum time to wait for the delete operation. Accepts Go duration syntax such as `30s` or `2h45m`; defaults to `5m0s`.
- `update` (String) Maximum time to wait for the update operation. Accepts Go duration syntax such as `30s` or `2h45m`; defaults to `5m0s`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vappcloud_project.production project_example
```
